packages.subtitle: Quick exterior clean
notes: Quick exterior-focused clean
Main image changes with vehicle size

packages.name: Basic Detail
packages.subtitle: Quick interior clean
notes: Quick interior-focused package
Main image changes with vehicle size

packages.name: Complete Detail
packages.subtitle: Our #1 choice
notes: Best all-around package
Main image changes with vehicle size

packages.name: Interior Detail
packages.subtitle: Full interior detailing

packages.name: Exterior Detail

addons.name: Full Clay Treatment
notes: Add-on service not included in any package
addons.pricing_basis: vehicle size; severe bonded contamination or overspray is quoted after inspection

condition_pricing.label: Normal bonded contamination
condition_pricing.when: Typical rail dust, sap haze and bonded road film after a proper wash.

condition_pricing.label: Heavy fallout / overspray

addons.pricing_basis: floor area, salt/stains, spill depth, extraction and disassembly needs

condition_pricing.label: Maintenance shampoo / light stains

condition_pricing.label: Heavy salt / beverage / repeated extraction

condition_pricing.label: Heavy crystallized salt
condition_pricing.when: Repeated winter buildup needs staged dissolving, agitation, extraction and drying.

addons.pricing_note: Starting prices are in CAD before HST. Vehicle size and condition can change labour. Quote-required services are not finalized until the condition/scope is reviewed.

addons.name: Headlight Restoration

condition_pricing.when: The problem is inside the assembly or the lens/assembly is physically failing.
